caption:
Not every lead deserves the same five-minute sprint.

Some need a call before you finish reading their name. Others just need to stay warm for three months.

The Lead Value Matrix sorts every inbound lead on two axes: what it's worth and how fast it needs an answer. Four quadrants, four different response rules.

Pull your last 20 leads and plot them this week. That exercise alone shows you which leads are eating your team's time and which are going cold.

rationale: Carousels still lead saves and depth for B2B authority content in 2026 benchmarks, and this ships an unclaimed value-times-urgency prioritization matrix distinct from every prior stage, ladder, ownership, aging-bucket, and channel-based framework already covered.
